'''Thioro''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served under [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Zsinj]].

==Biography==
In [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]], Thioro was part of a group that pretended to be a [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] military police force and arrested [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] of [[Wraith Squadron]], a New Republic [[Commando/Legends|commando]] unit, in a bar on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. It was a plot by [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Zsinj]] to gain a measure of revenge against the Wraiths for the destruction of the [[Implacable (Star Destroyer)/Legends|''Implacable'']], an [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] commanded by Zsinj's subordinate [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Apwar Trigit]].<ref name="if" />

Thioro claimed to be a [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] when asked by Wraith [[Garik Loran]], who immediately uncovered the plot when he recognized Thioro's walking mannerism didn't match a typical Corellian. Thioro's group was quickly incapacitated by the Wraiths after a short fight.<ref name="if" />

==Behind the scenes==
Thioro was a character created by author [[Aaron Allston]] for his novel ''[[X-Wing: Iron Fist]]'', the second novel in the [[Star Wars: X-Wing (novel series)|''Wraith Squadron Trilogy'']].<ref name="if" />
